name: com.profblu.argento/argento
title: Argento
description: Live data for Argentines abroad: flights home, events, places, products and consulates.

tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: Lists the cities Argento covers (Argentine community guides abroad) with country, time zone, current local time, airports and the canonical page of each city. Optionally filter by country (ISO code like ES or name). Responds in the requested language (lang: es, en, it).

country.description: Country ISO 3166-1 code (ES, IT, US…) or name in Spanish.

lang.description: Language of the labels and of the text summary: es (Spanish), en (English) or it (Italian). Use the language of the person asking.

tools.name: find_cheap_flights
tools.description: Reference prices of flights from a city abroad (Madrid, Barcelona, Rome, London, Paris, Miami, New York, Sydney…) to Argentina (Buenos Aires EZE/AEP, Córdoba COR, Mendoza MDZ, Rosario ROS): the cheapest one-way price per month, the cheapest round trip seen, this week's deals below the usual price and, if you pass a month, the cheapest departure days of that month. Prices are per person, from real searches, with the date they were checked; each route includes its Argento page and links to flight search sites. Argento does not sell tickets. Responds in the requested language (lang: es, en, it).

origin.description: Where the trip starts: an Argento city (slug or name in Spanish, English or Italian) or one of its airport codes (MAD, BCN, FCO, LHR, JFK…).

destination.description: Argentine airport: EZE (Buenos Aires Ezeiza), AEP (Aeroparque), COR (Córdoba), MDZ (Mendoza), ROS (Rosario). Omit for all routes from the city.

month.description: Month of departure (YYYY-MM) to get the cheapest days of that month. Omit to compare months.

lang.description: Language of the labels and of the text summary: es (Spanish), en (English) or it (Italian). Use the language of the person asking.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: Upcoming Argentine events in a city abroad (concerts, peñas, folk and tango nights, theatre, comedy, talks, football screenings, festivals), with local time and Buenos Aires time, venue and address, and the Argento page of each event. Filter with a date range. Responds in the requested language (lang: es, en, it); event titles come as published.

city.description: The city: its slug from list_cities (madrid, new-york…), its name in Spanish, English or Italian (Madrid, New York, London, Londra…) or one of its airport codes (MAD, JFK).

from.description: First day (YYYY-MM-DD, city time). Default: today in the city.

lang.description: Language of the labels and of the text summary: es (Spanish), en (English) or it (Italian). Use the language of the person asking.

tools.name: find_argentine_places
tools.description: Argentine businesses in a city abroad: parrillas and restaurants, cafés, bakeries (medialunas, facturas), grocery stores (almacén), bars, ice cream shops and cultural centres, nearest to the city centre first, with address, whether they are open now, phone, website, Instagram and the Argento page of each place. Filter by type, by a word in the name or address, or open now. Responds in the requested language (lang: es, en, it).

city.description: The city: its slug from list_cities (madrid, new-york…), its name in Spanish, English or Italian (Madrid, New York, London, Londra…) or one of its airport codes (MAD, JFK).

type.description: restaurant (parrilla, empanadas…), cafe, bakery (panadería), food_shop (almacén, Argentine grocery), bar, cultural_center, ice_cream (heladería).

query.description: Word to look for in the name or address (accents not needed).

open_now.description: Only the places open right now.

lang.description: Language of the labels and of the text summary: es (Spanish), en (English) or it (Italian). Use the language of the person asking.

tools.name: where_to_buy
tools.description: Where to buy an Argentine product in a city abroad (yerba mate, mate and bombilla, dulce de leche, alfajores, empanada wrappers, facturas and medialunas, 0000 flour, Fernet, Argentine wine, Argentine beef cuts, chorizo and morcilla, cheese and cold cuts, golosinas, chimichurri…): shops confirmed to sell it, shops the community saw it in, with price when known, shops that may have it, and how to ask for it locally. If the product is not tracked, returns the products Argento tracks in that city. Responds in the requested language (lang: es, en, it).

city.description: The city: its slug from list_cities (madrid, new-york…), its name in Spanish, English or Italian (Madrid, New York, London, Londra…) or one of its airport codes (MAD, JFK).

product.description: The product, in Spanish or as it is known (yerba, dulce de leche, alfajores, fernet, malbec, vacío…).

lang.description: Language of the labels and of the text summary: es (Spanish), en (English) or it (Italian). Use the language of the person asking.

tools.name: consulate_info
tools.description: The Argentine consulate that serves a city abroad (address, phone, email, website, opening hours) and how to do its procedures step by step: book an appointment, renew the national ID (DNI) and passport, vote from abroad, and register the citizenship of children born abroad. Each procedure includes the official source and the date it was reviewed. Responds in the requested language (lang: es, en, it); the steps come as published, in Spanish.

city.description: The city: its slug from list_cities (madrid, new-york…), its name in Spanish, English or Italian (Madrid, New York, London, Londra…) or one of its airport codes (MAD, JFK).

topic.description: Only one procedure: appointment, id-card (DNI and passport), voting or citizenship. Omit for all.

lang.description: Language of the labels and of the text summary: es (Spanish), en (English) or it (Italian). Use the language of the person asking.
